title: Light weight, flimsy but does work .
text:
Light weight, flimsy but does work .. You get what you pay for with this small 4 cup hamilton beach food processor.
Its flimsy, and lite weight .

First I wanted to grate cheese. I had the 2 latches snapped down to the bottom, plug it in ready to go. But this did not go on for me!
No matter what I did it did not go on..I then Took the whole thing apart again, and figured the top thingie did not push down the little starting device which is under the handle.
I then kept pushing it down with my finger nail..It finally worked.
When this did finally work, I noticed I had to hold the top down cause this had allot of vibration,(flimsy)
Although this has 4 suction cups at the bottom, which did suction to my granite counter.

Had my cheese cut up small ready to grate, but Not small enough for this Little chute, and I mean little.
Although It did grate the cheddar cheese, after I cut it up in small pieces.
I cannot imagine using this for grading potatoes for hash browns etc. I would have to cut those up in tiny pieces.
Easier using a hand grater.

The blades for chopping are double. Two at the bottom and two more at the top. Very sharp.
But if I want to use this for chopping, or pulsing, You have to attach the top which includes the chute which your not going to use.
A pain in the neck, and also for washing.
For grating, I’ll be using my larger food processor that has a larger chute.

So the question is for me , do I want to go through all this mess, and more to wash just using this for chopping!
I have 4 cup Oster with the red top, that is allot easier to clean, use, and less money.

Btw I have other Hamilton Beach products and love them. Not this one.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach Stack & Snap 4-Cup Mini Food Processor & Vegetable Chopper, 250 Watts, for Slicing, Shredding, and Puree, Black (70510)
features: VERSATILE & COMPACT 4 CUP FOOD PROCESSOR: Chop and puree food, blend smoothies, and slice or shred vegetables and cheese with this versatile Hamilton Beach food processor. Its compact design is perfect for small kitchens.
PREVENT SPILLS WITH 4 CUP LEAK-PROOF BOWL: The leak-proof bowl holds 4 cups and has a pour spout that's great for serving smoothies and processing liquids without spills.

SUPERIOR CHOPPING & BLENDING RESULTS: With a stainless steel quad blade and powerful motor, you'll get great results whether you're chopping or blending. The reversible disc is ideal for slicing and shredding vegetables and other foods.

EASY STACK & SNAP ASSEMBLY. The unique design of this small chopper/food processor and smoothie blender requires no difficult twist locking. The bowl stacks easily on the base and intuitive clips secure the lid to the bowl. Simple function guide helps you choose the right blade
SAVE PREP TIME WITH LARGE FEED CHUTE: You'll save time and reduce the need for pre-cutting every time you process food with this vegetable chopper. The large feed chute fits a whole block of cheese.
description: The Hamilton Beach® Stack & Snap™ 4 Cup Food Processor & Blender is versatile and compact. It has a large feed chute, leak-proof bowl with pour spout and lid, and unique design that eliminates twist locking.
